posts.hook: Anthropic's IPO may get pricier before it even lists
posts.caption: anthropic's bankers are weighing a higher ipo price after heavy demand, the nvidia scandal is turning into chip export policy, and microsoft patched 1,093 flaws in a single month. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's bankers weigh raising the IPO price, a target of ==$1.5 trillion or more==
slides.desc: A day after a $70 to $78 range, heavy demand may push the terms back up.

slides.title: The Nvidia scandal is turning into chip export policy
slides.desc: Sources say limits in this year's defense bill are now far likelier; shares fell another 5.47%.

slides.title: Microsoft patched ==1,093 flaws== in one month, one Outlook bug already under attack
slides.desc: 5,100+ patches this year, up from about 100 a month. Microsoft credits AI bug-finding.

slides.title: Grok Build is exposing thousands of its users' private apps
slides.desc: Shared links can be enumerated, researchers found. Unlisted is not access control.

terms.gloss: the app-building coding agent from Elon Musk's merged SpaceX and xAI

slides.title: Microsoft Research backdoors an AI agent by rewiring fewer than 10 neurons
slides.desc: It passes safety evals until a hidden trigger fires. Model files are a supply-chain risk.

slides.title: Doubling an engineer's AI token spend bought about 10% more commits
slides.desc: A JetBrains study of 404 engineers: token spend measures usage, not results.

posts.hook: Anthropic's IPO pitch: our AI now ports itself to new chips
posts.caption: anthropic's ipo has drawn orders for several times the shares on offer, and its roadshow video claims mythos ported claude to amd chips in three days. deepmind released alphagenome 2, and prosecutors allege a $129m ai impersonation fraud. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic says ==Mythos ported Claude to AMD chips in three days==
slides.desc: Its IPO roadshow video claims almost no human help. A sales pitch, not an audit.

terms.gloss: anthropic's top model, available only to approved organizations

slides.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 predicts what a DNA mutation does in each cell type
slides.desc: Trained on 100M+ cell profiles across 68 tissues. Open to non-commercial research.

slides.title: Three arrested over an AI impersonation fraud that allegedly took ==$129M==
slides.desc: Prosecutors say faked executive and lawyer voices talked staff into wiring money.

slides.title: AI chip startups raise billions: Fractile at $7B, Tenstorrent at $6.2B
slides.desc: Fractile was worth about $1.1B in May. Investors are funding alternatives to Nvidia.

slides.title: Cloudflare bets its global control plane on a leaderless consensus algorithm
slides.desc: Meerkat runs QuePaxa: no single leader whose bad link can stall every write.

terms.gloss: a 2023 method for servers to agree on data without electing a leader

slides.title: Campaigns spent about $187M on AI-made ads in the US midterms
slides.desc: About 300 ads counted by the Wesleyan Media Project; 90% backed Republican candidates.
